location: DFARS 252.225-7052 and 252.225-7961; DPCAP memorandum of October 5, 2026

en.title: DFARS 252.225-7052 and 252.225-7961: is there guidance on performance before an existing contract is modified?
en.summary: The DPCAP memorandum of October 5, 2026 directs contracting officers to incorporate 252.225-7961 and remove 252.225-7052 in existing contracts as soon as practicable, and not to request consideration when making the modification under FAR 1.107(d). Clause 7052 applies its upstream restriction to deliveries from January 1, 2027. Clause 7961 and the statute as amended by section 848 attach it to contracts awarded on or after that date. One reading keeps the 7052 text binding on performance until the modification is made. The other treats the amended statute and the directed replacement as removing the upstream restriction for contracts awarded before that date.
en.impact: No specific contract awaiting this modification has been identified.
en.correction: Please indicate whether supplementary guidance addresses performance pending the directed modification.

quotes.text: Section 848 amends section 844 of the NDAA for FY 2021 to clarify that the restriction at 10 U.S.C. 4872(a) on covered materials mined, refined, or separated in a covered country applies only to contracts awarded on or after January 1, 2027.
